description: This file manages Feishu account configurations, including resolving credentials, handling secret references, and listing accounts within a larger application. It includes functions for normalizing data, error handling, and merging configurations.

classes.name: FeishuSecretRefUnavailableError
classes.description: Custom error class indicating an unresolved secret reference in Feishu credentials.

methods.name: isFeishuSecretRefUnavailableError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a FeishuSecretRefUnavailableError.

methods.name: resolveFeishuSecretLike
methods.description: Resolves a secret reference or string for Feishu credentials, throwing an error if unresolved in strict mode.

methods.name: resolveFeishuBaseCredentials
methods.description: Resolves core Feishu credentials (appId, appSecret, domain) from config.

methods.name: resolveFeishuEventSecrets
methods.description: Resolves event-related secrets (encryptKey, verificationToken) from config.

methods.name: resolveDefaultFeishuAccountSelection
methods.description: Determines the default Feishu account ID and its source based on configuration.

methods.name: resolveDefaultFeishuAccountId
methods.description: Returns the default Feishu account ID from configuration.

methods.name: mergeFeishuAccountConfig
methods.description: Merges top-level config with account-specific config, with account config overriding top-level.

methods.name: resolveFeishuCredentials
methods.description: Resolves full Feishu credentials, including secrets, with configurable resolution modes.

methods.name: inspectFeishuCredentials
methods.description: Resolves Feishu credentials in inspect mode, treating unresolved secrets as unavailable.

methods.name: buildResolvedFeishuAccount
methods.description: Builds a resolved Feishu account snapshot with credentials and configuration.

methods.name: resolveFeishuAccount
methods.description: Provides a read-only snapshot of a Feishu account, treating unresolved secrets as unavailable.

methods.name: resolveFeishuRuntimeAccount
methods.description: Resolves a runtime Feishu account with strict credential requirements if specified.

methods.name: listEnabledFeishuAccounts
methods.description: Lists all enabled and configured Feishu accounts.
